declared_family.polarization: fixed K-compatible polarization lambda:A_gen->Ahat_gen; Rosati restricts to complex conjugation on K
declared_family.poincare_kernel: normalized Poincare line bundle P on A_gen x Ahat_gen
declared_family.endo_kernel: Q=(id_A x lambda)^* P on A_gen x A_gen
declared_family.functor: Psi_Q(F)=Rp2_*(p1^*F tensor^L Q), canonically Llambda^* Phi_P(F) by flat base change
declared_family.source_class: all coherent sheaves F pure of codimension 3 (dimension 3) on A_gen
declared_family.output_type_hypothesis: NONE; output is allowed to be an arbitrary derived object

grr.degree_law: H^{2j}(A)->H^{12-2j}(Ahat), hence ch_j maps to target ch_(6-j)
grr.codim3_consequence: target ch_3 receives exactly and only source ch_3
grr.pure_support_leading_term: for pure codim-3 F, ch_0=ch_1=ch_2=0 and ch_3(F)=[F]_cyc

block_map.selector_consequence: T_lambda preserves W_K=B_0+B_6 and its p=1,...,5 complement, so Pi_W T_lambda = T_lambda Pi_W on H^6
block_map.invertibility: Phi_P^H is an integral cohomology isomorphism and lambda^* is a rational cohomology isomorphism for the isogeny lambda; hence T_lambda|W_K is invertible

terminal_theorem.no_new_seed: This declared Poincare-polarization middle-support FM family cannot create the first exceptional algebraic seed. A positive output requires an algebraic source support cycle that is already exceptional.
terminal_theorem.missing_datum: an explicitly algebraic codimension-3 support cycle gamma=[F]_cyc on the same non-split target with Pi_W(gamma)!=0

adversarial_audit: No semihomogeneity is assumed or inferred; the proof is cohomological and applies regardless of target output type.
No WIT or single-cohomology-sheaf assumption is used; Chern character is taken for the derived output.
No divisor-algebra hypothesis is used. The source support cycle may be any algebraic codimension-3 cycle arising from a pure sheaf.
No split/discriminant-minus-one secant object is transported to the [-3] target.
The result does not show Pi_W([F])=0 for every algebraic support cycle; that would overclaim the unresolved algebraicity question.
A source with Pi_W([F])!=0 is not a counterexample to the theorem: it is exactly a pre-existing seed, and the FM transform only transports it.

finite_certificate.scope: finite verification of degree/block labels and the frozen H0N projector values only; it does not replace GRR or the geometric leading-cycle theorem
